{{Top|leg}}
The '''Swivel gun''' was a weapon commonly mounted on the [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]] during [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. More powerful than the standard [[Laser cannon/Legends|Laser cannon]], this made the aging Chariot more adapt for combat.
